subject.title: feat: show Codex transcripts in the sidebar

question: Should Codex supervision make every non-archived session a primary sidebar surface and expose persisted transcripts across opted-in paired computers?
rationale: This changes primary Control UI navigation and the paired-node consent/approval surface; the implementation is plausible, but final product placement and upgrade expectations require explicit owner intent.

options.title: Sponsor the full sidebar surface
options.body: Accept the host-grouped sidebar and paired-node transcript viewer after the generated-output and proof gates are satisfied.

options.title: Keep transcripts in the catalog page
options.body: Retain bounded transcript reading but avoid automatically hydrating and displaying the full fleet in the primary sidebar.

options.title: Defer remote transcript access
options.body: Land only local transcript viewing and revisit paired-node reads after a signed fleet-upgrade validation path exists.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the full sidebar surface
recommendation.body: Accept the host-grouped sidebar and paired-node transcript viewer after the generated-output and proof gates are satisfied.

likelyOwner.reason: This person opened the linked product request and owns the most recent focused Codex catalog and macOS integration history.
